name: Your Local Mechanic
desc:
This game is in Alpha right now you may find a lot of bugs.

Update new car graphics update.  The main car has been updated with new graphics and style of play.  You can only fix the part that is assigned from the customer.  More updates to come soon with the new graphics update.  


Learn to fix cars with this Mechanic Sim. Many different parts to fix. Tow your customers cars back to your shop and help them get back on the road. Thanks for ######### for helping build some new models. Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/My/Groups.aspx?gid=4722423
